name: add_terraform_variable_bounds_validation
description: Add validation blocks bounding instance_count (1-10) and restricting environment to an allowlist; broken validates only one of the two variables
prompts: main.tf has two input variables - instance_count (number) and environment (string) - with no guards, so a plan with instance_count = -1 or environment = "prd" (a typo) is accepted and fails later, expensively. Add a `validation` block to EACH variable: instance_count must be between 1 and 10 inclusive, and environment must be one of dev/staging/prod (use contains(...)). Each validation needs a condition and a clear error_message. Run `terraform fmt`. Leave the null_resource and the variable types/defaults unchanged.

test_setup_files.check_validation.py:
import json
import re
import subprocess

fmt = subprocess.run(["terraform", "fmt", "-check"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert fmt.returncode == 0, f"terraform fmt -check failed:\n{fmt.stdout}\n{fmt.stderr}"

init = subprocess.run(["terraform", "init", "-backend=false", "-input=false"],
                      capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
assert init.returncode == 0, f"terraform init failed:\n{init.stdout}\n{init.stderr}"

validate = subprocess.run(["terraform", "validate", "-no-color", "-json"],
                          capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(validate.stdout)
assert data.get("valid") is True, f"terraform validate failed: {validate.stdout}"

content = open("main.tf", encoding="utf-8").read()

# Both variable blocks must carry a validation with a condition + message.
def var_block(name):
    m = re.search(
        r'variable\s+"' + name + r'"\s*\{(.*?)\n\}', content, re.DOTALL)
    assert m, f"variable {name!r} block not found"
    return m.group(1)

for name, needle in [("instance_count", "instance_count"), ("environment", "environment")]:
    block = var_block(name)
    assert "validation" in block, f"variable {name!r} has no validation block"
    assert re.search(r"condition\s*=", block), f"variable {name!r} validation has no condition"
    assert re.search(r"error_message\s*=", block), f"variable {name!r} validation has no error_message"

# The instance_count bounds and the environment allowlist must be expressed.
ic_block = var_block("instance_count")
assert re.search(r"instance_count\s*(>=|<=|>|<)", ic_block), (
    "instance_count validation must bound the value numerically")
env_block = var_block("environment")
assert "contains(" in env_block and "prod" in env_block, (
    "environment validation must restrict to an allowlist including prod")

print("PASS terraform variable-validation checks")
